prompt:
Estimate the crack-initiation life, in flights, of a lower wing skin detail.

**Stress history**
Each flight produces this sequence of turning points at the detail (ksi), ground to ground:

`-6, 14, 8, 19, 11, 24, 9, 21, 13, 17, 7, 16, -6`

Flights follow one another with the identical sequence.

**Data and practice**
- Cycle counting: rainflow (ASTM E1049), applied to the history as it repeats flight after flight, so that every counted cycle is closed.
- Mean-stress correction: Goodman with Ftu = 78 ksi, Sa,eq = Sa / (1 − Sm/Ftu) for Sm > 0; Sa,eq = Sa for Sm ≤ 0.
- Fully reversed S-N curve: Sa,eq = 95 · N^(−0.15) (ksi; N = cycles to failure). Cycles with Sa,eq below 6.0 ksi do no damage.
- Palmgren–Miner linear damage; failure at a damage sum of 1.0; no scatter factor.

**Report**
1. Rainflow cycles per flight
2. Maximum and minimum stress of the largest-range cycle
3. Damage per flight
4. Life in flights

Show your working. End with a single JSON object in a ```json code block, with exactly these keys and plain numbers:

```json
{"cycles_per_flight": 0, "largest_cycle_max_ksi": 0, "largest_cycle_min_ksi": 0, "damage_per_flight": 0, "life_flights": 0}
```
response:
Step-by-step working

1 Rain-flow counting (ASTM E1049)  
The turning-point string for one flight is

-6, 14, 8, 19, 11, 24, 9, 21, 13, 17, 7, 16, -6

Running the standard three-point rain-flow algorithm on this closed string gives  

• 10 full cycles  
• 1 half cycle (because the very first valley –6 is also the last valley when flights are concatenated).  

List of cycles obtained

| # | Smax (ksi) | Smin (ksi) | Range (ksi) | Count |
|---|------------|------------|-------------|-------|
|1|14|8|6|1.0|
|2|19|14|5|1.0|
|3|14|11|3|1.0|
|4|24|14|10|1.0|
|5|14|9|5|1.0|
|6|21|14|7|1.0|
|7|14|13|1|1.0|
|8|17|14|3|1.0|
|9|14|7|7|1.0|
|10|16|14|2|1.0|
|11|14|-6|20|0.5|

That is 10.5 counted cycles per flight.

2 Largest-range cycle  
The largest range is 20 ksi, coming from the half-cycle between –6 ksi and 14 ksi, so  
Smax = 14 ksi,  Smin = –6 ksi.

3 Damage calculation  

For every cycle:

Sa = range / 2 ;  Sm = (Smax + Smin)/2  
Goodman correction (Ftu = 78 ksi):

 Sa,eq =  Sa / (1 – Sm / 78) (if Sm > 0)  
 Sa,eq = Sa       (if Sm ≤ 0)

Only cycles whose corrected amplitude exceeds the endurance limit 6 ksi are damaging; all others are ignored.

Two cycles qualify:

a) 24↔14 (full cycle)  
 Sa = 5 ksi, Sm = 19 ksi  
 Sa,eq = 5 /(1 – 19/78) = 6.611 ksi  
 Nf  = (95 / 6.611)^(1/0.15) = 5.23×10^7 cycles  
 Damage  D = 1/Nf = 1.91×10^-8

b) 14↔-6 (half cycle)  
 Sa = 10 ksi, Sm = 4 ksi  
 Sa,eq = 10 /(1 – 4/78) = 10.54 ksi  
 Nf  = (95 / 10.54)^(1/0.15) = 2.30×10^6 cycles  
 Damage  D = 0.5 / Nf = 2.17×10^-7

Total damage per flight  

Dflight = 1.91×10^-8 + 2.17×10^-7 = 2.36×10^-7

4 Crack–initiation life  

Life (flights) = 1 / Dflight = 1 / 2.36×10^-7 = 4.23×10^6 flights.

------------------------------------

------------------------------------

